rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the sweet crystals used in food and drinks.

example.english: I don't need to add so much sugar to my coffee.
example.jyutping: jam2 gaa3 fe1 m4 sai2 lok6 gam3 do1 tong4

rows.note: Use 糖尿病 specifically for the medical condition diabetes.

example.english: The doctor says I have diabetes, so I need to eat less sugar.
example.traditional: 醫生話我有糖尿病，所以要少食糖。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jau5 tong4 niu6 beng6 so2 ji5 jiu3 siu2 sik6 tong4

rows.note: Use 寶貝 as an affectionate form of address for a loved one, rather than for actual sugar.

example.jyutping: bou2 bui3 nei5 gam1 jat6 gui6 m4 gui6 aa3

rows.note: Use 一啖錫 for the noun idea of a kiss or a bit of kissing affection.

example.english: Come on, sugar, give me a kiss before you go.
example.jyutping: zau2 zi1 cin4 bei2 ngo5 jat1 daam6 sik1 laa1
